tldr: Mars in the 12th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into the hidden, spiritual, and unconscious
body: Mars in the 12th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into the hidden, spiritual, and unconscious. Gift: real force there. Watch: friction and impatience. With Mars in the 12th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, dreams, release, and spiritual repair. This makes how you meet what is private, unconscious, unfinished, or ready to be released a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through the hidden inner life.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in the hidden inner life.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
